name: mica
description: Mica — a Git-native content editor for Astro websites.

scripts.//backup: There is no backup script: the content is in Git, and the database holds only sessions.
scripts.//release:version: Sets the one version every manifest carries, and checks the changelog has a section for it. Pushing the tag is what publishes.
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist sites/*/node_modules sites/*/dist examples/*/node_modules examples/*/dist
